Stay safe 🇿🇦

✅ VERIFIED means SA Opportunities found this same vacancy on the employer's own official website, and the Apply button takes you to that official site (for example Capitec's own careers page).

⚠️ BOARD LISTING means the job was seen on a job board but has NOT yet been traced to the employer's site. Check carefully before applying.

🚫 Never pay to apply
Real employers never ask applicants for money, airtime, 'registration fees', or payment for training/uniforms before an interview. If they do — walk away.

🔍 Check the address
Look at the website address before typing personal details. Capitec is capitecbank.co.za — lookalike spellings are scams.

📵 WhatsApp-only jobs
A real company may WhatsApp you AFTER you apply officially, but 'apply on WhatsApp only' with no official listing is a major red flag.

About this app
SA Opportunities scans official employer career pages and known SA job boards 3 times a day, traces listings back to the employer, filters scam patterns, and publishes the results free. No tool can guarantee every listing is genuine — always use the checks shown on each job.
